Introduction

In Malaysia’s fast-growing e-commerce landscape, a live commerce agency helps brands and sellers broadcast real-time product demonstrations, promotions, and interactive sessions on platforms like TikTok, Shopee Live, and Facebook Live. One essential service offered by these agencies is the provision of live stream viewers — real audience numbers that make your broadcast appear active, credible, and engaging. The live commerce agency Malaysia price for this service varies depending on the number of concurrent viewers, duration of the stream, and the platforms supported.

For local businesses in Kuala Lumpur, Penang, or Johor Bahru, investing in a reliable live stream viewers service can significantly improve social proof during a live sale. Agencies like Beriklan, which has been running ad campaigns since 2016, offer transparent pricing packages tailored to Malaysian ringgit budgets. Understanding the cost structure helps you plan your marketing spend without overcommitting.

Key Benefits

  • Enhanced social proof – A higher viewer count signals to organic audiences that your stream is worth watching, encouraging more real viewers to stay and interact.
  • Improved algorithm performance – Platforms like TikTok and Shopee rank live streams with higher concurrent viewers more favourably, increasing your organic reach.
  • Cost-effective audience building – Instead of spending heavily on ads to attract viewers, you can purchase a targeted viewer package that fits your budget and stream schedule.
  • Flexible scalability – Whether you need 50 viewers for a product launch or 500 for a major campaign, packages can be adjusted to match your event size and frequency.

How It Works

  1. Choose your package – Select the number of concurrent viewers (e.g., 50, 100, 200) and the stream duration (e.g., 1 hour, 3 hours, or a full day). Most agencies offer tiered pricing in RM.
  2. Provide stream details – Share your live stream link (TikTok, Shopee Live, Facebook Live, etc.) and the scheduled start time. The agency will prepare the viewer system to join at the exact moment.
  3. Go live as usual – Start your broadcast. The viewers will appear gradually within the first few minutes, mimicking organic growth. You can continue presenting your products without interruption.
  4. Monitor and adjust – Some agencies provide a dashboard or real-time support. If you need to extend the stream, additional viewer time can be added on the spot.

Pricing in Malaysia

Typical live commerce agency Malaysia price for live stream viewers ranges from RM990/month for a basic package (e.g., 50 concurrent viewers for 2 hours per stream, 4 streams per month) to RM3,500/month for larger packages with 200–500 viewers and longer durations. One-off single-stream packages start around RM250 for 50 viewers for 1 hour.

Several factors affect the final cost: the number of viewers (higher counts require more bandwidth and infrastructure), the platform (some platforms have stricter anti-bot detection, requiring higher-quality viewers), the length of the stream, and whether you need viewers from specific demographics (e.g., Malay, Chinese, or Indian audiences). Agencies that have been in the market since 2016, like the Beriklan team, typically offer more stable and compliant services because they have refined their delivery methods over years. For a detailed breakdown, you can review the live stream viewers pricing page.

Frequently Asked Questions

Are these viewers real people or bots?

Reputable agencies provide real or high-retention simulated viewers that behave like genuine users — they join, stay for the duration, and may even follow your account. Bots that are easily detected can harm your account’s standing, so always choose a provider with a track record. For reference, businesses can verify an agency’s legitimacy through their Google Business Profile to see reviews and history.

Can I use viewers on multiple platforms at the same time?

Most packages are platform-specific. If you stream simultaneously on TikTok and Shopee Live, you will need separate viewer packages for each platform. Some agencies offer multi-platform bundles at a discounted rate. Always confirm with the provider before purchasing.

How quickly do the viewers appear after I go live?

Viewers are typically injected within the first 1–3 minutes of your stream to appear natural. The agency will coordinate with you to ensure the timing aligns with your broadcast start. If you experience delays, most agencies have live chat support to adjust the delivery.

Conclusion

Choosing the right live commerce agency in Malaysia involves balancing your budget with the quality of viewer service you receive. How It Works

  1. Discovery and planning: We discuss your business, target audience, and goals. You share any branding materials or examples you like. We then prepare a sitemap and wireframe.
  2. Design and review: Our team creates a visual mockup of your website. You review and request changes. We refine until you are satisfied with the look and feel.
  3. Development and testing: We code the site using modern frameworks, integrate any necessary features (contact forms, payment gateways, booking systems), and test on different devices and browsers.
  4. Launch and handover: Once testing is complete, we deploy the site to your domain, provide a brief training session, and hand over login credentials. We remain available for any post-launch adjustments.

Pricing in Malaysia

Website development costs in Malaysia vary widely based on complexity, features, and the level of customisation. A simple brochure-style website (5–10 pages) typically starts from RM990/month on a subscription model that includes hosting, maintenance, and minor updates. For a more advanced e-commerce site with product management, payment integration, and inventory tracking, expect pricing from RM2,500/month upwards. One-time project fees for a standard business website range between RM3,000 and RM8,000, while custom platforms with databases and APIs can exceed RM15,000.

Factors that affect the final cost include the number of pages, design revisions, third-party integrations (e.g., accounting software, CRM), content creation (copywriting, photography), and ongoing support requirements. We always provide a transparent quotation before any work begins. For a detailed breakdown, visit our website development page to see package options and what is included.
